page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a list of short paragraphs beginning with italic terms. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre-left with page number at top right. Catchword "Radix" at lower right.

main_text.p: Collectiva, quâ nutrimentum superfluum ad certam partem corporis animati colligitur, ut ex eo semen ibi generetur.
Separativa, quâ semen jam absolutum in corpore animato separatur, ut ex eo in locum convenientem illapso aliud generari queat.
Corpora ita viventia ex ipso semine praecipuè ca-lorem & humorem radicalem fortiuntur.
Plura quoq; obtinent membra distincta : quo-rū alia magis homogenea, alia magis sunt heterogenea.
Homogenea-magis membra, his corporibus communia, sunt, cùm nervus & vena, tum gluten.
Nervus est pars oblonga, durior & tenax, cohæ-rentiam[?] reliquis partibus corporis præstans.
Vena est pars etiam oblonga, sed cava, mollior nervo, per quam alimentum in totam substantiam corporis defertur.
Gluten est pars, quæ ex alimento è venis elapso incrassato orta, nervis ac venis annata, cum iis unum membrum compositum corporis animati constituit.
Actalis pars, si mollis sit, Caro dicitur.
Partes magis-heterogeneæ sunt, quæ ex homogeneis compositæ, distinctæ ad distinctas animæ operationes perficiendas sunt aptæ. unde etiam Organicæ appellantur.
Porrò jam Plantæ perfectioris vitæ, ex magis-he-terogeneis partibus peculiariter obtinent radi-cem, & quæ ex ea enascuntur.

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic in places as shown; the "ç" in "cohæ-rentiam" and "aptę" is a ligature-like form and is copied as ę/æ with [?] where uncertain. The hyphenation at "cohæ-" is not clearly visible on the scan. Short letter after "quo-" appears as "rū" with macron. The catchword "Radix" is printed at right below the last line. The stamp at bottom left is a digitiser or shelf mark and is omitted.
